title: Marketplace Expansion Through Marquee Seller Adoption: Externalities and Reputation Implications
eligible_reason: The identifying variation is the entry of marquee sellers onto a B2B auction platform at common calendar dates: two superior-quality entrants (GS on 2013-01-22 and CE on 2013-03-28, pooled into one pre/post window) and one inferior-quality entrant (GZ, single entry date = first auction on site 36). Treatment is assigned by seller category (is_cc: sellers in the entrants' categories - consumer electronics, computers, cell phones - versus jewelry/toys sellers as controls), not by unit-specific adoption dates, so there is one adoption date per event and no staggered rollout. The only regression code in the package (Figure 2 scripts) estimates lm(log(median_rr) ~ is_cc * factor(time_count)) and glm.nb(n_auct / tot_reve_round / n_sell ~ is_cc * factor(time_count)) on a seller x 30-day-period panel with a group dummy and period dummies, no seller fixed effects; the count outcomes are negative binomial. The abstract describes the main results as a difference-in-difference-in-differences (entrant quality x unbranded-seller quality x post), i.e. a subgroup-by-treatment interaction around a single date. The README promises 43 table folders, but the archive contains only 'Figure 1' and 'Figure 2' scripts, and all data are synthetic replacements for confidential platform data.
design_notes: replication_package_MS-OPM-22-03606: README.docx, synthetic data dictionary.docx, data/ (13 synthetic files: auct_sup_gscx.rdata, auct_sup_gz.rdata, auct_sup.rdata, auction_bid_order.csv 726 MB, customer_address.csv, df_bs_ce_gs.rdata, df_order_sup_gz_21_29.rdata, df_order_sup.rdata, df_reg_GSCX_slct.rdata, df_reg_GZ_slct.rdata, is_part_df_mkt_stl.rdata, marque_ent_summary.rdata, product_category_ptmcategory.csv, unsold_auction_sup.rdata), Figure 1/ (two descriptive R scripts), Figure 2/ (DiD_CCC_mon_lvl_spr.R for the superior entrants, DiD_CCC_mon_lvl_ipr.R for the inferior entrant). Scripts load data from Dropbox URLs listed in the dictionary. Figure 2 construction: time_count = 30-day periods since the public marketplace (site 2) opened; treated sellers = sellers with won auctions in ccc_cat before 2014-01-01; control sellers = jewelry/toys sellers; outcomes per seller-period: n_auct, n_sell, tot_reve, median_rr (median final price / retail price); pre window periods 23..GS_enter_tc-1, post window CE_enter_tc+1..42 (superior) and 4..GZ_enter_tc-1 / GZ_enter_tc+1..20 (inferior); GS_CE_ent = time_count > CE_enter_tc. No seller FE (is_cc group dummy instead), coefficients on is_cc x period dummies plotted as event-time paths.

screener_notes: Screened from package only. Full-text flags 'difference-in-difference(s)' and 'staggered' probably refer to the two entries occurring at different dates (superior vs inferior entrant events), not to unit-level staggered adoption.
